retainedDiagnostics.resolution: One 5-second release-fixture timeout under concurrent validation (6411/6412 passed). The isolated 17-case fixture lane and fresh full 6412-case run with four workers pass; no timeout/assertion relaxation.
Early GL qualification still hit WebGPU-only fixture helpers (32 failures, 20 passes). Backend-neutral observations now read actual GL allocations and preserve actual WebGPU readback oracles.
Two observations inspected a genuine pending GL sort credit before completion. The observation now awaits the renderer completion boundary; zero-credit and native/history assertions remain.

The accepted-transform fixture called an unavailable Tools action. Setup now opens Tools and waits for the actual Apply readiness; final real loss/preview recovery passes. The four before-optimization measurements remain diagnostic observations.
A fixture tried uploading a native map while its accepted color session remained owned. It now retires its fixture map and uses the controller native settlement/map owner; both actual backends pass.

Stress-query coordinates used framebuffer coordinates after downsampling. The fixture now centers its complete region in the unchanged selection-map grid. No production projection/query behavior changed.
The independent WGSL readback fixture initially concatenated a vec4 textureLoad with vec2 center metadata. Corrected to sample.xy; production shaders were unchanged.

The documentation amendment initially left commas unquoted in the compact capability CSV. Quoting and exact byte/digest binding were corrected; all 10 policy/ledger cases and source/product verification pass.
22 coordinate fixtures imported development-only TypeScript URLs. They now use separate shipping native core/camera WASM modules, preserving independent native projection expectations.

After native-coordinate correction, 40 passed and two deliberate private source-owner injection tests were inapplicable to a static bundle. They remain unchanged and pass in the development-only lane; the declared public production cohort passes 40/40.
